verdict.rationale: Entra ID can be driven programmatically without the portal. Microsoft Graph exposes a single API endpoint with documented operations such as listing users. SCIM APIs automate user and group provisioning, and lifecycle workflows run automatically against users. However, nothing in the evidence shows how to run headlessly in CI, such as non-interactive authentication or a CLI. Missing for 10: documented CLI or CI tooling, non-interactive service-principal or workload-identity authentication for pipelines, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of headless or CI use.
